{{Quote|I don't know which of you is the bigger fool&mdash;you two&hellip; or that meddling Jedi!|[[Unidentified Weequay agent 1|The Weequay leader]], to this agent and [[Unidentified Weequay agent 3|another one]]|<ref name="Sabotage (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.38|Sabotage (comic story)}}</ref>}}
This '''Weequay agent''' worked for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Along with [[Unidentified Weequay agent 3|another agent]], he served under a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 1|leader]] and infiltrated a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Unidentified Coruscant funeral firm|funeral firm]] with forged credentials in an attempt to sabotage the [[Funeral of Halsey|funeral]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]].
